008package paint.viewer.override.recording_override;
009
010/**
011 * Represents a single recording-level override entry. Each instance defines replacement
012 * threshold parameters for one recording, identified by the (experimentName, recordingName)
013 * pair.
014 * <p>
015 * This class models one row from the "Recording Override.csv" file located in the Viewer
016 * directory of a PAINT project. It is a simple data container designed for direct CSV parsing
017 * and in-memory consumption by ImportRecordingOverride and related override/export utilities.
018 * The values stored here replace the corresponding threshold parameters (density ratio, R²,
019 * variability, neighbour mode) on the target recording.
020 * </p>
021 * <ul>
022 *   <li>Plain data container (POJO) with no behavior.</li>
023 *   <li>Field layout mirrors the Recording Override CSV columns.</li>
024 *   <li>Used exclusively for override import/export and in-memory mutation.</li>
025 * </ul>
026 */
027public class RecordingOverride {
028
029    private String experimentName;
030    private String recordingName;
031
032    private double minRequiredDensityRatio;
033    private double minRequiredRSquared;
034    private double maxAllowableVariability;
035    private String neighbourMode;
036
037    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
038    // CONSTRUCTORS
039    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
040
041    /**
042     * Default constructor required for CSV parsing and reflective instantiation.
043     */
044    public RecordingOverride() {
045    }
046
047    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
048    // ACCESSORS
049    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
050
051    public String getExperimentName() {
052        return experimentName;
053    }
054
055    public void setExperimentName(String experimentName) {
056        this.experimentName = experimentName;
057    }
058
059    public String getRecordingName() {
060        return recordingName;
061    }
062
063    public void setRecordingName(String recordingName) {
064        this.recordingName = recordingName;
065    }
066
067    public double getMinRequiredDensityRatio() {
068        return minRequiredDensityRatio;
069    }
070
071    public void setMinRequiredDensityRatio(double minRequiredDensityRatio) {
072        this.minRequiredDensityRatio = minRequiredDensityRatio;
073    }
074
075    public double getMinRequiredRSquared() {
076        return minRequiredRSquared;
077    }
078
079    public void setMinRequiredRSquared(double minRequiredRSquared) {
080        this.minRequiredRSquared = minRequiredRSquared;
081    }
082
083    public double getMaxAllowableVariability() {
084        return maxAllowableVariability;
085    }
086
087    public void setMaxAllowableVariability(double maxAllowableVariability) {
088        this.maxAllowableVariability = maxAllowableVariability;
089    }
090
091    public String getNeighbourMode() {
092        return neighbourMode;
093    }
094
095    public void setNeighbourMode(String neighbourMode) {
096        this.neighbourMode = neighbourMode;
097    }
098
099    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
100    // DEBUG
101    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
102
103    /**
104     * Returns a human-readable representation of this override entry,
105     * primarily intended for logging and debugging.
106     */
107    @Override
108    public String toString() {
109        return "RecordingOverride{" +
110                "experimentName='" + experimentName + '\'' +
111                ", recordingName='" + recordingName + '\'' +
112                ", minRequiredDensityRatio=" + minRequiredDensityRatio +
113                ", minRequiredRSquared=" + minRequiredRSquared +
114                ", maxAllowableVariability=" + maxAllowableVariability +
115                ", neighbourMode='" + neighbourMode + '\'' +
116                '}';
117    }
118}
